values.note: 30 A + water C$30 a night, 30 A full service C$35; monthly C$800 / C$950 prepaid. The C$24 15-amp sites are tent sites. Taxes extra. A regional park pass is sold by the season (C$50 on the park's own page, C$65 on the regional parks site).

fees.source: https://kindersleyregionalpark.ca/ (Camping Fees: 'Electric, Sewer & Water Site Per Night $35.00'; 'Per Month (Prepaid) $950.00'; 'Electric Site Per Night $30.00'; 'Per Month (Prepaid) $800.00'; '15 Amp Per Night $24.00'; 'Regional Park Pass Seasonally $50.00'); https://saskregionalparks.ca/park/kindersley/ ('30 Amp and Water Daily $30.00'; '30 Amp, Water and Sewer Daily $35.00'; '(prices subject to applicable taxes and change without notice)'; 'Park Entry: $65.00/season'), read 2026-11-18

note: Regional park inside the Town of Kindersley beside the Motherwell Dam reservoir, ringed by a 4.2 km paved trail; the 9-hole golf course is across the road. Renters must be 18 or older. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park), thin booking evidence. 51 sites (20 x 30 A full service, 25 x 30 A + water, 6 x 15 A tent); fees 24-35 -> 30-35 (15 A sites are tent sites), taxes extra; season May 1 - Sep 30 confirmed. Not waterfront kept. Pin ~225 m WSW of the loop (in a housing block): optional move. Google 3.8 (45).
